review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for a zero-padding construction (zeroPad, extend, Matrix.Data) and found no existing matrix zero-padding definition. The nearest candidates, `Matrix.submatrix`, `Matrix.fromBlocks` and `Matrix.reindex`, give restriction or block forms, not a padding map on `Fin`-indexed matrices. `zeroPadMatrix` is therefore a specific, non-redundant construction. `padSource` and `MatrixAlgorithm.pad` are specific to this repo's own `MatrixInput` and `MatrixAlgorithm` types, and `RectangularAdmissibleExponent` is likewise a local concept. `sum_fin_castLE_of_zero` and `zeroPadMatrix_mul` are theorems, so standalone theorem duplication is excluded. A parallel complex-only copy of the same definitions exists in `ComplexArithmetic/MatrixPadding.lean` (namespace `Foundation.Arithmetic`). That is an in-repo duplicate, not a competing version of a Mathlib concept, so I did not report it. Remaining uncertainty: I did not search every Mathlib file exhaustively for an equivalent of `sum_fin_castLE_of_zero`.
